stemMd: In a conventional technical drawing, what does a dashed line most commonly represent when the legend specifies hidden edges?

options.label: A
options.textMd: An edge concealed behind visible surfaces

options.label: D
options.textMd: An edge that must be cut away

options.label: E
options.textMd: A boundary that does not exist

explanationMd: Under the stated convention, dashed lines communicate geometry hidden by nearer surfaces. They distinguish concealed edges from visible outlines. The drawing legend removes ambiguity about the convention being used.

distractorRationale.d: A hidden edge need not be removed.
distractorRationale.b: Line type does not specify the unit here.
distractorRationale.c: The stated legend assigns hidden geometry.
distractorRationale.e: The edge exists but is occluded in this view.
